title: Oral Exam: Foundations of Quantum Computation
subtitle: 20 Thought-Provoking Conceptual Problems for a 30-Minute Viva (Chapters 1–6)
intro: These 20 questions probe conceptual understanding, structural intuition, and physical vision across Chapters 1 through 6. They are designed for a 30-minute viva-voce or oral examination, tracing the foundations of computation from classical deterministic and reversible models to stochastic systems, state geometry, composite entanglement, and quantum parallelism.
